[Open the GeoCalor dashboard (Portuguese)](https://geocalor.icict.fiocruz.br/){.btn .btn-primary}

**GeoCalor** studies the impacts of **heat waves** by combining climate and health data. It focuses on the three most populous metropolitan areas of each region of Brazil.

The dashboard brings together **climate characterization**, **heat waves**, **epidemiological profile** and **early warning systems**. It helps users see patterns, detect anomalies and support monitoring, risk communication and health planning. The goal is to produce scientific evidence for the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS).

![Sections of the GeoCalor dashboard.](../../imagens/geocalor.png)

## What the dashboard shows

| Section | Content |
|---|---|
| Climate characterization | mean temperatures, anomalies and seasonality in 15 metropolitan areas, 1981–2025 |
| Heat waves | frequency, duration and intensity of events, with maps, charts and a calendar by city and year |
| Epidemiological profile | hospitalizations and deaths from cardiovascular and respiratory diseases, by region and year |
| Mortality × heat waves | relationship between heat waves and cardiovascular/respiratory mortality |
| Hospitalization × heat waves | statistical association between heat waves and hospital admissions |
| Early warning systems | review and comparison of international heat-wave warning systems |

A project of the **Laboratory of Geography, Environment and Health (LAGAS/UnB)**, published by ICICT/Fiocruz.
